## Research and reproducibility safeguards

- [ ] Historical runs and their metrics remain clearly distinguished.
- [ ] Development tuning is separated from locked-test evaluation.
- [ ] Dataset versions, configuration, seeds, and checksums are recorded for new experiments.
- [ ] Synthetic tests are not presented as benchmark results.
- [ ] Evidence retention, retrieval, and answer accuracy are reported as distinct measures.
